summary_1line: A Brahmana deduces many causes of a Rakshasa’s sorrow; Bhishma then explains gifts, Sraddha rites, and moral rules that please gods and ancestors.

image_candidates.scene_text: A gaunt Rakshasa listens as a calm Brahmana lists the hidden sorrows that have made him pale and lean.
At a Sraddha rite, a man offers three rice-balls—one cast into water, one given to his wife, and one placed into the blazing fire.
A penitent ascetic stands on one foot atop a mountain with arms raised, gazing at a blazing fire under the scorching sun.
